152986f33e50441163d5bfc4f403a6b8.overview: If they miss The Beatles' first appearance in the U.S.A., they will hate themselves for the rest of their lives - so four young girls from New Jersey set off even though they don't have tickets for the show! The journey is full of surprises and misfortunes but the young ladies are determined to reach their idols.
152986f33e50441163d5bfc4f403a6b8.tagline: Some girls will do anything to meet their idols.

153fd34efd70af570a7180ea631e0a98.overview: Aurora, a finicky woman, is in search of true love while her daughter faces marital issues. Together, they help each other deal with problems and find reasons to live a joyful life.
153fd34efd70af570a7180ea631e0a98.tagline: Come to laugh, come to cry, come to care, come to terms.

15465638080c9154cd01e17634f0e890.overview: A Sydney lawyer defends five Aboriginal people in a ritualised taboo murder and in the process learns disturbing truths about himself and premonitions.
15465638080c9154cd01e17634f0e890.tagline: Hasn't the weather been strange ...could it be a warning?

1548c5c98bac22e9638de74789a34608.overview: An exploration of the cult of the genius, an anti-heroic figure who chooses to be a social outcast and live on the fringe of bourgeois morality.

15772d9662783cf4a16835b6590aa970.overview: Obsessed scientist Dr. Henry Frankenstein attempts to create life by assembling a creature from deceased body parts. Aided by his loyal misshapen assistant, Fritz, Frankenstein succeeds in animating his monster, but it flees into the countryside and begins to wreak havoc.
15772d9662783cf4a16835b6590aa970.tagline: The man who made a monster.

158db56c4e79b5a9a1a4cf313ee1bcf3.overview: A salmon fisherman has to choose between a bad girl and a society doll.
158db56c4e79b5a9a1a4cf313ee1bcf3.tagline: One Woman -- In a Land of Men

1595fb8140fd2c99df8a860ca7f6ff1b.overview: Wounded Civil War soldier John Dunbar tries to commit suicide—and becomes a hero instead. As a reward, he's assigned to his dream post, a remote junction on the Western frontier, and soon makes unlikely friends with the local Sioux tribe.
1595fb8140fd2c99df8a860ca7f6ff1b.tagline: Inside everyone is a frontier waiting to be discovered.

15a5aac9e5bee0eeea56b3560fd66321.overview: An exploration of Burroughs’ life story, as told by Burroughs himself along with many of his contemporaries, including Allen Ginsberg, Brion Gysin, Francis Bacon, Herbert Huncke, Patti Smith, Terry Southern, and William Burroughs Jr.

15ac4827d028029b2226c7fcec8e0193.overview: A Danish family visits a Dutch family they met on a holiday. What was supposed to be an idyllic weekend slowly starts unraveling as the Danes try to stay polite in the face of unpleasantness.

15adffd7be57a64da91030e6cf65d882.overview: Petra von Kant is a successful fashion designer -- arrogant, caustic, and self-satisfied. She mistreats Marlene (her secretary, maid, and co-designer). Enter Karin, a 23-year-old beauty who wants to be a model. Petra falls in love with Karin and invites her to move in.
